name: Phase2 S1-v2 exploratory closed-loop

stages.0: M0,M3,M5 once D.5 d.8 offset0; stop campaign on technical validation failure
stages.1: M0 D.25,.5 x index1,2; no dynamic; annotate delay failures; do not remove D
stages.2a: M0 d.8,1 x D.25,.5 x index1..4
stages.branch: any 2a SAFETY_FAILURE/STUCK =>2b else2c; technical/placement failures not counted as policy failures
stages.2b: same16 pairs, run index then d then D, each M3 then M5
stages.2c: M0 d.6 D.5,.75 x index1..4; only failed M0 SAFETY_FAILURE/STUCK get M3 then M5; no more runs

oracle: first visible RGB then NEXT actual capture completion; controller reads geometry only after this monotonic timestamp
executor: sample0 unchanged: original PP .2; changed sample or accepted graph: frozen variable speed. ALL_UNSAFE fallback sample0 constant speed. Endpoint/timeout stop semantics preserved.
graph: Import unchanged GraphV4 and protocol. One CPU process, one outstanding. B frozen at controller-tick dispatch; worker start/IPC delay separate. Previous actual command; immediately previous accepted corrected path only if preceding actual FRESH was accepted Graph; otherwise no previous prior.
graph_timeout_semantics: Deadline includes dispatch, worker/SDF/init/solve/certificate/return; solver wall also logged. Reject elapsed>.5 at receive; do not retime original FRESH 1s lifetime. During waiting hold active command only while its original receive age<1s, then timeout STOP. New FRESH queued FIFO; one actual switch per tick. Expired queued inputs recorded unapplied.
graph_empty_geometry: No fabricated obstacle for unchanged v4 SDF; if invoked with no public obstacles, INIT_REJECT and M3 fallback; record reason.
selection: sample0 if public native full safe; else safe sample lowest unchanged v4 zero-edit endpoint deficit/index; none=>sample0 ALL_UNSAFE
feasibility: Saved actual spawn and first-visible-FRESH switch B; existing Phase B B0/B1 settings30000exp/120CPU s/60path s; post-run offline, no control input or execution blocking; NO_PATH_FOUND not impossibility.
classification: SUCCESS goal+no overlap+no corridor intrusion; SAFETY_FAILURE overlap/corridor OR conservative contact stop separately flagged; STUCK90s timeout; MARGIN_VIOLATION independent. Placement_invalid and technical failures separate.
statistics: Exploratory N4 main; N2 delay baseline. Wilson95 descriptive only. Paired differences matched run index; bootstrap fixedseed20261022,10000resamples descriptive. No Graph necessity claim.
branch2c_reporting: 2a16 have M3/M5 NOT_RUN if branch2c; no fabricated all-success pairs. Hard subset paired only failed M0; selection bias explicit.
fixed_graph_initialization: M3 selected sample; no tuning/restarts; failed/stale graph fallback M3
safety_scope: Oracle geometry, Isaac RGB closed-loop SE2 kinematic, not PhysX robot

dynamic_rendering.rule: Existing RGB_MAGENTA rule and VisibilityGate unchanged
